instagram:
Customer ne ek sawal poochha: kya aap Mohali mein delivery karte hain? Aapki website par jawab nahi mila. Woh chala gaya. 😬

Visitor aapki kahani padhne nahi aata, apne sawal ka jawab dhundhne aata hai. Jawab lambe paragraphs, company history aur mission statement ke beech dabaa ho, to woh dhundhta nahi, wapas chala jaata hai.

Ek interior designer ki website par har service ek hi bade paragraph mein thi, aur pricing ka zikr nahi tha. Har service ka alag page banaya, upar ek line mein jawab, neeche starting range. Ab customers jankari lekar aate hain.

Is reel mein:
✅ Har service ka apna alag page
✅ Har page ki pehli line mein seedha jawab
✅ Chhoti lines, headings aur bullet points
✅ Ek FAQ section, menu mein 5 se 6 items se zyada nahi

Test: kisi dost ko apni website dijiye aur poochhiye, 'inki timing kya hai?'. Jahan woh atka, wahin content theek karna hai.

Aapke customers sabse zyada kaun sa sawal baar baar poochhte hain? Comment mein batao 👇
